name: Thai Li Ba
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Thai Li Ba in Innsbruck**

Discover the vibrant flavors of **Thai cuisine** in the heart of the **Alpenland Tirol**. At **Thai Li Ba**, we bring you an authentic taste of Thailand—spicy, aromatic, and full of life—right in the middle of **Innsbruck**’s bustling city center.

Our menu features **pad thai**, **green curry**, and **massaman curry**, all crafted with fresh ingredients and a touch of **Tirol**’s alpine charm. Whether you’re craving a light **tom yum soup** or a hearty **khao soi**, every dish is made with passion and care.

Join us for a culinary adventure where **Thai flavors** meet **Tirol**’s cozy atmosphere. Come hungry—you won’t leave unsatisfied!

**Thai Li Ba**
*Your gateway to Thailand in Innsbruck*
